stage: SNPE CPU-body/DSP-head hybrid conversion and physical-device generation verified
validationScope: Float split-body outputs and states exactly matched six source partitions on three fixtures each. Four augmented-L2 vocabulary heads matched float references within 1.15e-5; full-vocabulary top-1 matched in three fixtures. The same DLC files completed Japanese-to-Korean and held-out English-to-Korean generation on BOOX Go103_2 / SM6350 / V66 / Android 15. English generation used this final execution plan, FP32 attention mask -10000 and 256-token output limit. Full-NPU A8 translation was inaccurate and is not distributed. Other physical devices, broad quality, long documents and a performance advantage remain unverified.

calibration.body: One fixture per half to quantize W8 parameters; CPU FLOAT32 does not execute quantized activations
calibration.head: Three multilingual sequences, non-thinking official chat template, 136 total token steps; representative prompt/answer boundary samples

performanceNote: One graph resident at a time. This is a compatibility/benchmark path, not a speedup claim. Temporary-manifest Japanese fixture took about 177.5 seconds excluding preparation.
npuVerificationScope: vocabulary projection only; decoder body executes CPU FLOAT32

deviceValidation.memoryScope: App process samples only, excludes separate DSP/driver allocations; Japanese fixture
